name: Codeblock
description: Displays a block of code with syntax highlighting and a copy button.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "rouge"

module RubyUI
  # A block of code, styled after shadcn's CodeBlock (Base UI + vega).
  #
  # Shorthand: Codeblock(code, syntax: :ruby) renders the code highlighted by
  # Rouge with a copy button in the top-right corner (clipboard: false drops
  # it). Without code it is the root of a composition: CodeblockHeader,
  # CodeblockTitle, CodeblockActions, CodeblockCopyButton, CodeblockContent,
  # CodeblockLine and CodeblockFooter.
  #
  # Syntax colors come from CodeblockTheme, rendered once in the <head>.
  class Codeblock < Base
    VARIANTS = {
      default: "border border-input text-foreground dark:bg-input/30 " \
        "has-[>[data-slot=code-block-content]:focus-visible]:border-ring",
      destructive: "border border-destructive/30 text-destructive dark:border-destructive/40"
    }.freeze

    SIZES = %i[default sm].freeze

    # clipboard_error: is deprecated and ignored: a failed copy shows nothing.
    def initialize(code = nil, syntax: nil, variant: :default, size: :default, clipboard: true,
      clipboard_success: "Copied", clipboard_error: nil, wrap: false, line_numbers: false,
      start_line: 1, **attrs)
      unless clipboard_error.nil?
        Warning.warn("RubyUI::Codeblock: `clipboard_error:` is deprecated and ignored " \
          "(a failed copy shows nothing, as in shadcn)\n", category: :deprecated)
      end
      @code = code
      @syntax = syntax
      @variant = variant.to_s.to_sym
      @variant = :default unless VARIANTS.key?(@variant)
      @size = size.to_s.to_sym
      @size = :default unless SIZES.include?(@size)
      @clipboard = clipboard
      @clipboard_success = clipboard_success
      @content = {wrap: wrap, line_numbers: line_numbers, start_line: start_line}
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        @code.nil? ? block&.call : shorthand
      end
    end

    private

    def shorthand
      if @clipboard
        render CodeblockActions.new do
          render CodeblockCopyButton.new(value: @code, copied_label: @clipboard_success)
        end
      end
      render CodeblockContent.new(@code, syntax: @syntax, **@content)
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "code-block", variant: @variant, size: @size, controller: "ruby-ui--codeblock"},
        class: [
          "group/code-block relative flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-lg text-sm data-[size=sm]:text-xs",
          "has-[>[data-slot=code-block-content]:focus-visible]:ring-3 has-[>[data-slot=code-block-content]:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50",
          VARIANTS.fetch(@variant)
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

module RubyUI
  # Buttons for the block. Inside a CodeblockHeader they sit at its end; as a
  # direct child of Codeblock they float in the top-right corner and show on
  # hover or focus (always on touch screens).
  class CodeblockActions < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "code-block-actions"},
        class: [
          "ms-auto -me-1.5 -my-1 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1",
          "[[data-slot=code-block]>&]:absolute [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:end-3 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:top-3 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:z-10 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:m-0",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:[[data-slot=code-block]>&]:end-2 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:[[data-slot=code-block]>&]:top-2",
          "[[data-slot=code-block]>&]:opacity-0 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:transition-opacity",
          "[[data-slot=code-block]>&]:group-focus-within/code-block:opacity-100 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:group-hover/code-block:opacity-100 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:pointer-coarse:opacity-100",
          "[[data-slot=code-block]>&]:*:[button]:bg-background [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:*:[button]:ring-1 [[data-slot=code-block]>&]:*:[button]:ring-foreground/10"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "rouge"

module RubyUI
  # The scrollable code: a focusable <pre> (so the keyboard can scroll it)
  # with a <code> inside.
  #
  # Given code, it highlights it with Rouge (syntax: any Rouge lexer name;
  # plain text without it) and, with line_numbers: true, renders one
  # CodeblockLine per line, numbered from start_line. Without code, the block
  # gives its own content, usually CodeblockLines (e.g. a diff with
  # variant: :added / :removed). wrap: true wraps long lines instead of
  # scrolling sideways.
  class CodeblockContent < Base
    FORMATTER = ::Rouge::Formatters::HTML.new

    def initialize(code = nil, syntax: nil, wrap: false, line_numbers: false, start_line: 1, style: nil, **attrs)
      @code = code
      @style = style
      @syntax = syntax
      @wrap = wrap
      @line_numbers = line_numbers
      @start_line = start_line.to_i
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      pre(**attrs) do
        code(
          data: {slot: "code-block-code"},
          class: "grid min-h-lh min-w-max content-start in-data-numbered:grid-cols-[auto_1fr] in-data-wrap:min-w-0"
        ) do
          if @code.nil?
            block&.call
          elsif @line_numbers
            lines.each { |line| render CodeblockLine.new { raw(safe(line)) } }
          else
            # One grid item: Rouge's spans would each take a row of the grid.
            span { raw(safe(FORMATTER.format(lexer.lex(@code)))) }
          end
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def lexer
      (@syntax && ::Rouge::Lexer.find(@syntax.to_s)) || ::Rouge::Lexers::PlainText
    end

    # Highlighted HTML per line, without the trailing newline, so each line's
    # spans close inside its CodeblockLine.
    def lines
      lines = [[]]
      lexer.lex(@code.chomp).each do |token, value|
        value.split(/(\n)/).each do |part|
          if part == "\n"
            lines << []
          elsif !part.empty?
            lines.last << [token, part]
          end
        end
      end
      lines.map { |tokens| FORMATTER.format(tokens) }
    end

    # One declaration list: Phlex's mix would join our string with the
    # caller's style without a separator. The caller's style comes last, so it
    # wins, as in shadcn ({counterReset, ...style}).
    def style
      own = "counter-reset: line #{@start_line - 1};"
      theirs = @style.is_a?(Hash) ? @style.map { |k, v| "#{k.to_s.tr("_", "-")}: #{v};" }.join(" ") : @style.to_s.strip
      theirs = "#{theirs};" unless theirs.empty? || theirs.end_with?(";")
      [own, theirs].reject(&:empty?).join(" ")
    end

    def default_attrs
      data = {slot: "code-block-content"}
      data[:wrap] = true if @wrap
      data[:numbered] = true if @line_numbers
      {
        dir: "ltr",
        tabindex: 0,
        style: style,
        data: data,
        class: [
          "min-h-0 min-w-0 scroll-fade-x scrollbar-thin overflow-auto px-4 py-4 text-start font-mono leading-relaxed outline-none",
          "data-wrap:scroll-fade-y data-wrap:wrap-break-word data-wrap:whitespace-pre-wrap",
          "group-has-data-[slot=code-block-header]/code-block:pt-2 group-has-data-[slot=code-block-footer]/code-block:pb-2",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:px-3 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:py-3",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:group-has-data-[slot=code-block-header]/code-block:pt-1.5"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Copies value: (or, without it, the block's code) to the clipboard. After
  # copying, the icon turns into a check and the label into copied_label for
  # two seconds; a polite live region announces it. A failed copy shows
  # nothing, as in shadcn. Needs a Codeblock around it (its Stimulus
  # controller lives on the root).
  class CodeblockCopyButton < Base
    # error_label: is deprecated and ignored: a failed copy shows nothing.
    def initialize(value: nil, label: "Copy", copied_label: "Copied", error_label: nil,
      variant: :ghost, size: :xs, **attrs)
      unless error_label.nil?
        Warning.warn("RubyUI::CodeblockCopyButton: `error_label:` is deprecated and ignored " \
          "(a failed copy shows nothing, as in shadcn)\n", category: :deprecated)
      end
      @value = value
      @label = label
      @copied_label = copied_label
      @variant = variant
      @size = size
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      button = Button.new(variant: @variant, size: @size, icon: true, **attrs)
      # mix joins strings, so the Button's own slot would read "button code-block-copy-button".
      button.attrs[:data][:slot] = "code-block-copy-button"
      render button do
        copy_icon
        check_icon
      end
      span(aria_live: "polite", class: "sr-only", data: {slot: "code-block-copy-status"})
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      data = {
        slot: "code-block-copy-button",
        action: "ruby-ui--codeblock#copy",
        label: @label,
        copied_label: @copied_label
      }
      data[:value] = @value unless @value.nil?
      {aria: {label: @label}, data: data}
    end

    # lucide copy and check, as in shadcn; the button's data-copied picks one.
    def copy_icon
      icon(class: "group-data-copied/button:hidden") do |s|
        s.rect(width: "14", height: "14", x: "8", y: "8", rx: "2", ry: "2")
        s.path(d: "M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2")
      end
    end

    def check_icon
      icon(class: "hidden group-data-copied/button:block") do |s|
        s.path(d: "M20 6 9 17l-5-5")
      end
    end

    def icon(**, &)
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        width: "24",
        height: "24",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        **, &
      )
    end
  end
end

module RubyUI
  # A row below the code, for a caption or extra actions.
  class CodeblockFooter < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "code-block-footer"},
        class: [
          "flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-4 pb-4 text-muted-foreground",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:px-3 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:pb-3"
        ]
      }
    end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A row above the code: a CodeblockTitle and, on the right, CodeblockActions.
  class CodeblockHeader < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "code-block-header"},
        class: [
          "flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-4 pt-4 text-muted-foreground *:has-[>[data-slot=code-block-title]]:min-w-0",
          "group-data-[variant=destructive]/code-block:text-destructive",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:px-3 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:pt-3"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # One line of code. Numbered when its CodeblockContent has line_numbers:
  # true. variant: :added / :removed mark a diff (+ / − in the gutter),
  # :highlighted shades the line.
  class CodeblockLine < Base
    VARIANTS = {
      default: nil,
      added: "bg-muted after:content-['+']",
      removed: "bg-destructive/10 after:text-destructive after:content-['−']",
      highlighted: "bg-muted"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(variant: :default, **attrs)
      @variant = variant.to_s.to_sym
      @variant = :default unless VARIANTS.key?(@variant)
      super(**attrs)
    end

    # An empty line holds a newline so copying a selection keeps blank lines.
    def view_template(&block)
      span(**attrs) do
        span(data: {slot: "code-block-line-content"}, class: "min-w-0") do
          content = capture(&block) if block
          content.to_s.empty? ? plain("\n") : raw(safe(content))
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "code-block-line", variant: @variant},
        class: [
          "relative -mx-4 block min-h-lh px-4 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:-mx-3 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:px-3",
          "after:absolute after:start-1 after:top-0 after:text-muted-foreground after:select-none",
          "in-data-numbered:col-span-2 in-data-numbered:grid in-data-numbered:grid-cols-subgrid in-data-numbered:gap-x-3 in-data-numbered:[counter-increment:line]",
          "before:min-w-6 before:text-end before:text-muted-foreground",
          "in-data-numbered:before:content-[counter(line)] in-data-numbered:before:select-none",
          "in-data-numbered:supports-[content:counter(line)_/_'']:before:content-[counter(line)_/_'']",
          VARIANTS.fetch(@variant)
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "rouge"

module RubyUI
  # Syntax colors for every Codeblock: Rouge's GitHub theme, light by default
  # and dark under .dark. Render it once, in the layout's <head>. Plain text
  # keeps the block's text color (the theme's base color and background are
  # left out).
  class CodeblockTheme < Base
    SCOPE = "[data-slot=code-block-code]"

    def self.rouge_css(mode, scope)
      quoted = Regexp.escape(scope)
      ::Rouge::Themes::Github.mode(mode).render(scope: scope)
        .gsub(/^#{quoted} table[^\n]*\n/, "")
        .sub(/^#{quoted}, #{quoted} \.w \{[^}]*\}\n/, "")
    end

    CSS = [rouge_css(:light, SCOPE), rouge_css(:dark, ".dark #{SCOPE}")].join("\n").freeze

    def view_template
      style(**attrs) { raw(safe(CSS)) }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The file name (and an optional icon) in a CodeblockHeader.
  class CodeblockTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "code-block-title"},
        class: [
          "min-w-0 truncate font-sans text-sm font-medium text-foreground",
          "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:inline-block [&_svg]:align-middle *:[svg]:me-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
          "group-data-[variant=destructive]/code-block:text-destructive",
          "group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:text-xs group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Codeblock

Displays a block of code with syntax highlighting and a copy button.

## Setup

Syntax colors come from CodeblockTheme, Rouge's GitHub theme in light and dark. Render it once in the head of your layout: render RubyUI::CodeblockTheme.new

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
code = <<~CODE
  def hello_world
    puts "Hello, world!"
  end
CODE

Codeblock(code, syntax: :ruby)
```

### Without copy button

```ruby
Codeblock("bin/rails generate ruby_ui:component Codeblock", syntax: :shell, clipboard: false)
```

### Line numbers

```ruby
code = <<~CODE
  class User < ApplicationRecord
    has_many :posts
    validates :email, presence: true
  end
CODE

Codeblock(code, syntax: :ruby, line_numbers: true, start_line: 10)
```

### Header and footer

```ruby
code = <<~CODE
  Rails.application.routes.draw do
    resources :posts
  end
CODE

Codeblock do
  CodeblockHeader do
    CodeblockTitle { "config/routes.rb" }
    CodeblockActions do
      CodeblockCopyButton(value: code)
    end
  end
  CodeblockContent(code, syntax: :ruby)
  CodeblockFooter { "Ruby" }
end
```

### Diff

```ruby
gemfile = <<~GEMFILE
  source "https://rubygems.org"

  gem "ruby_ui", "~> 1.6"
  gem "rouge"
GEMFILE

Codeblock do
  CodeblockActions do
    CodeblockCopyButton(value: gemfile)
  end
  CodeblockContent do
    CodeblockLine { "source 'https://rubygems.org'" }
    CodeblockLine()
    CodeblockLine(variant: :removed) { "gem 'ruby_ui', '~> 1.5'" }
    CodeblockLine(variant: :added) { "gem 'ruby_ui', '~> 1.6'" }
    CodeblockLine(variant: :highlighted) { "gem 'rouge'" }
  end
end
```

### Wrap

```ruby
code = "curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash -s -- --prefix=/usr/local --with-extra-options --verbose"

Codeblock(code, syntax: :shell, wrap: true)
```

### Small

```ruby
Codeblock("bundle add ruby_ui --group development --require false", syntax: :shell, size: :sm)
```

### Destructive

```ruby
code = <<~CODE
  NameError: uninitialized constant User
    app/controllers/users_controller.rb:4:in 'index'
CODE

Codeblock(variant: :destructive) do
  CodeblockHeader { CodeblockTitle { "Error" } }
  CodeblockContent(code)
end
```

### Custom copy message

```ruby
Codeblock("puts 'Hello'", syntax: :ruby, clipboard_success: "Nice one!")
```
